about: The offertorium of the formulary “Seven Sorrows of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: Virgin Mother of God, when you stand before the Lord, remember to speak in our favor; and may He turn His wrath away from us.

w021.explanation: The form looks ahead to a time when Mary will already be standing before the Lord. English normally uses a present-tense verb in such a future time clause: “when you stand.”

w014.explanation: Mary is to speak on our behalf. The Lord is to turn His wrath away. The possessive refers back to the Lord as the subject of this second petition.
